findings.title: Scope of Work Defined
findings.rationale: The evidence clearly outlines the scope of products covered under the agreement, detailing the categories of products and services to be supplied by the Vendor to the Client.
evidence_excerpts: This Agreement covers the following categories of products supplied by Vendor to Client: Servers (Rack-mounted, Blade, and Tower), Networking Equipment (Switches, Routers, Firewalls), Storage Solutions (NAS, SAN, Cloud-enabled Storage), Peripheral Devices (UPS, Printers, Scanners), Consumables (Cables, Connectors, Batteries).

findings.title: Termination for Convenience Notice Period
findings.rationale: The evidence specifies the notice period required for termination of the agreement without cause.
evidence_excerpts: Either party may terminate the Agreement by providing 60 days written notice to the other party.

findings.title: Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
findings.rationale: The evidence explicitly outlines the process for dispute resolution and indicates the governing law applicable to the arbitration process.
evidence_excerpts: Any dispute arising from this Agreement shall first be addressed through amicable discussions between the parties. If unresolved, the matter shall be referred to arbitration under the Indian Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The place of arbitration shall be [City, State], India, and the proceedings shall be conducted in English.

findings.title: Payment Terms and Schedule
findings.rationale: The evidence clearly outlines the payment terms, including the due dates and conditions for late payments.
evidence_excerpts: Payment shall be made by Client within thirty (30) days from the date of invoice.

findings.title: Late Payment Penalties
findings.rationale: The contract specifies the penalties for late payments, including interest rates and conditions for suspension of deliveries.
evidence_excerpts: Late payments shall attract interest at 1.5% per month, calculated from the due date until the date of actual payment.

findings.title: Pricing Structure Defined
findings.rationale: The evidence explicitly outlines the pricing structure for the products and services provided by the Vendor to the Client, including details on base pricing, payment terms, and conditions for price revisions.
evidence_excerpts: The pricing structure, terms, and conditions applicable to the sale and supply of electronic hardware products and related services provided by Vendor to Client.

findings.title: Price Revision Clause Present
findings.rationale: The contract includes a clause that allows for price revisions based on certain conditions, indicating a form of price escalation mechanism.
evidence_excerpts: Vendor may revise the prices annually, subject to inflation, changes in raw material costs, or new technology adoption.
